jobs.prompt: Runner bug (parts S17): swarm go --scope fails before wave 1 with 'Job T-0457: cacheContext must be 1-10 unique paths that are also in context', though no ticket field sets cacheContext. Cause: tools/ticket-manifest.mjs sets job.cacheContext from the shared context (ticket-context.mjs), and later steps that drop context (the non-text drop around line 40 which only filters cacheContext to the remaining context, wave-prep dropping missing or pending test paths and oversize context in tools/scope-commands.mjs) can leave cacheContext empty or naming a path no longer in context, which validateManifest (tools/swarm/core-31.mjs around line 424) refuses. Fix at the source: add one exported helper normalizeCacheContext(job) in tools/ticket-manifest.mjs that dedupes, keeps only paths still in job.context, caps at 10 (sorted), and deletes the field when nothing is left or when the job's agent is not anthropic or auto; call it at the end of ticketsToManifest for every job and wherever wave prep removes context from a job (including the non-text drop and the finalizeScopeWaveManifest park/drop paths and applyUncoveredTestReferences). Tests in tests/cache-context-normalize.test.mjs: a ticket with no shared context builds a job with no cacheContext field and the manifest validates; a ticket whose only shared context file is binary or missing ends without cacheContext; cacheContext with 12 shared files is capped at 10 and valid; a CLI-lane job carries no cacheContext. Keep tests/ticket-manifest.test.mjs, tests/wave-prep-context.test.mjs, tests/wave-prep-robust.test.mjs, tests/scope-commands.test.mjs and tests/api-workers.test.mjs passing.
